name: ANA●HOLIC!
source:
Dig, get dug, and dig back! (Fuck, get fucked, and fuck back!)

Work together with your fellow excavators, using your strength, and sometimes your body,
to open a tunnel through the gigantic Dragon God Mountains teeming with monsters!
translation:
挖洞、被挖，再挖回去！（操人、被操，再操回去！）

与一同开掘隧道的伙伴齐心协力，运用力量，有时也得献上身体，
在魔物横行的巨大龙神山脉中打通一条隧道！
